subject: Re: Scheduling demo — reprioritized for Q3 launch
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@tesseractlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:15:00Z
Subject: Intro + demo scheduling for Tesseract Labs (Redwood)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together a short 30–40 minute demo focusing on 1) inference latency and cost tradeoffs, 2) Redwood’s Dedicated options for predictable throughput, and 3) a quick look at the Optimize suggestions for an embeddings-heavy workload.

Would next Tuesday (Aug 10) at 11:00 AM PT work for you and the platform team? If that slot is tight, I can also do Aug 11 (same window). Agenda and a short demo-agenda.pdf attached.

If the team prefers, we can tighten the agenda to a 20 minute executive overview + 20 minute tech Q/A.

Best,

— Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0183

Attachment(s): demo-agenda.pdf
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@tesseractlabs.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T17:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + demo scheduling for Tesseract Labs (Redwood)

Camila —

Appreciate the follow up and the agenda. Unfortunately we just had a roadmap change — our core product team just kicked off an aggressive Q3 launch (feature freeze next week) and we need everyone focused there for the next 6–8 weeks.

That means any new POC work (including the Redwood inference demo) needs to be deprioritized for now. I’m really sorry — this is timing on our side, not a reflection on the conversation.

Can we park the demo and check back around mid-September? If you have a short one-page summary or mutual action plan I can circulate internally to keep momentum, that would help.

— Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Engineering | Tesseract Labs
elena.morales@tesseractlabs.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@tesseractlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + demo scheduling for Tesseract Labs (Redwood)

Thanks for the update, Elena — totally understand and congrats on the launch push.

I’ll park the demo for now and we’ll plan to re-open in mid-September. In the meantime I attached a concise mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (one page view) that summarizes the proposed kickoff steps, success criteria, and a suggested 4–6 week pilot timeline should you want to pick this back up sooner. I also included a note that the Dedicated pool can be scoped later to match whatever cadence you choose.

If it’s helpful, we can set an automated reminder for Sept 15 to re-check timelines — otherwise I’ll reach out the week of Sept 13.

If you want any internal-facing bullets I can draft a short note you can paste into your roadmap doc.

Best of luck with the launch week, and let me know if anything changes.

— Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0183

Attachment(s): mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@tesseractlabs.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-17T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + demo scheduling for Tesseract Labs (Redwood)

Camila —

Thanks for the flexibility and for the MAP — that’s perfect for me to share with the director and PMs. Circling back around mid-September sounds right; please go ahead and set a calendar check-in for the week of Sept 13 and include the one-pager you mentioned.

Also, if Redwood has any concise notes on security/compliance (SOC 2 readiness summary), please include that in the thread — it’s useful for procurement to eyeball while we’re in freeze.

I’ll update you if the launch timeline slips.

— Elena
